articles.title: Eurozone Inflation Strongest Since 2023
articles.expand: Eurozone inflation accelerated to the highest level in nearly three years in August, reinforcing expectations for an interest rate hike at the European Central Bank's meeting next week. Inflation advanced to 3.3 percent in August, as expected, from 2.9 percent in July, flash data from Eurostat revealed Tuesday. The rate was the highest since September 2023, when inflation was 4.4 percent.
